Boyette Creek has 556 homes and hundreds of great neighbors — and it’s time we all got to know each other a little better. Welcome to The Boyette Creek Buzz, your new quarterly neighborhood newsletter. We hope this becomes something you look forward to every season.

April — Events & Reminders
🍂 Neighborhood Leaf & Yard Clean-Up
Keep Our Streets Looking Great!
Yard waste rules: Bag or bundle clippings, leaves & trimmings — max 4 ft / 50 lbs per bundle. Set out Tuesday mornings. Keep separate from recycling cart.
Excess? Self-haul free to a county facility — bring photo ID + tax bill.

Featured Story
Go Green This Spring — Florida-Friendly Landscaping Tips
With Hillsborough County’s water restrictions in effect through July 1, 2026 (lawn watering limited to one day per week), spring is the perfect time to rethink your yard. Florida-Friendly landscaping can cut your water bill by up to 40%, reduce maintenance, and attract butterflies and pollinators.
🌱 Native Plants for Tampa Bay
Sunshine Mimosa — pink puffball flowers, mowable
Frogfruit — drought & flood tolerant, mowable
Twinflower — lavender blooms year-round, sun or shade
Beach Sunflower — bright yellow, blooms year-round
Coontie — evergreen, shade tolerant, drought hardy
Perennial Peanut — yellow flowers, low maintenance
Find nurseries: plantrealflorida.org
🌿 Grass Alternatives & Groundcovers
Mulch beds — retains moisture, stops weeds
Asiatic Jasmine — dense mat, great in shade
Lantana — heat & drought tolerant, attracts butterflies
Native wildflower borders — colorful, pollinator-friendly
Perennial groundcovers — replace turf under trees
All landscaping changes need ARB approval first.
🎓 Free Workshops + County Rebate
Hillsborough FLIP Program
Convert 500 sq ft of turf to a water-wise landscape and qualify for a rebate! Free 3-part workshop series: March 21, April 25 & May 30, 2026.

Community Rules
🚗 Vehicles & Parking
Park only in garage, paved driveway, or paved street
Inoperative vehicles must be in garage; not visible > 48 hrs
Boats, trailers, RVs, motorcycles — garage only
No commercial vehicles parked overnight on property
Street/road parking issues → contact HCSO, not the HOA
🗑️ Trash & Recycling
Garbage: Tuesdays & Fridays
Recycling & Yard Waste: Tuesdays only
Bins out no earlier than evening before pickup day
Bins returned no later than evening of pickup day
Bins must be hidden from view at all other times
Recycling: place loosely in blue cart — never bagged
Yard waste: bagged/bundled, max 4 ft / 50 lbs
📦 Bulk & Large Item Pickup
Call (813) 272-5680 before placing items at curb
$30/item: mattresses, furniture, TVs under 50", lawn mowers, carpet
$50/item: fridges, washers/dryers, water heaters, ovens, TVs 50"+
Self-haul free at county facility (bring ID + tax bill)
🐾 Pets
Must be on leash or inside a fully fenced area at all times
No exterior animal shelters or housing permitted
Pets that disturb neighbors may be required to leave
All Hillsborough County leash laws apply at all times
🔇 Noise & Nuisances
No objectionable noise, fumes, odors, or smoke discernible outside
No interference with neighbors’ TV or radio reception
All use must allow residents peaceful enjoyment of property
🌀 Hurricane & Storm Prep
Storm shutters: ARB approval required for permanent installation
Shutters may be placed up to 72 hours before a forecast storm
Shutters must be removed within 10 days after the storm passes
Leaving shutters up long-term is a safety and security violation
Metal roofs: shingle-style only, ARB req’d — approved colors: tan, brown, black, gray
Generators: ARB req’d, side of home near meter, with screening & concrete pad
pad
🏠 Property Changes — ARB Required
ALL exterior changes require written ARB approval before work begins
Includes: paint, roofing, fencing, pools, driveways, landscaping, additions
Submit an Alteration Application at boyettecreekhoa.com
Plans must include design, size, materials, and location details
Work must match approved plans exactly — changes void the approval
Violations may result in forced reversal at the owner’s expense
🌿 Landscaping & Lot Maintenance
All lots must be kept neat, mowed, and free of debris at all times
Front and side lawns must be fully sodded (except approved areas)
No tree removal without ARB written approval of a landscape plan
Swales must be maintained by owner to allow proper drainage
No filling, excavating, or obstructing drainage swales
🏊 Pools & Outdoor Structures
Pools may not be in the front or side yard of any lot
All pool equipment must be screened from street and neighboring lots
Play structures and yard accessories must be in the rear yard
Basketball hoops: ARB approved, well-maintained, transparent/white backboard, white net, metal pole
No skateboard ramps permanently installed in any non-rear area
🪟 Exterior Features
No security bars on any windows or doors
No satellite dishes over 1 meter (smaller ones OK, not visible from front)
No exterior telecom masts, towers, or antennas > 12 ft without ARB approval
All oil tanks and mechanical equipment must be screened from view
All driveways must be solid concrete or ARB-approved decorative pavers
🪧 Signs
No advertising, banners, billboards, or solicitation signs permitted
For sale or lease: one sign allowed, max 4 sq ft per side (2 sides max)

🛠️ Sidewalk Repairs
Each owner is responsible for maintaining the sidewalk abutting their lot
Hillsborough County Sidewalk Repair Partnership offers cost-sharing
Apply Oct 1 – June 30, or until funds run out
Eligible: trip hazards > ¼", slopes > 3", pooling water > ½"
Apply online at hcfl.gov → Roads and Sidewalks
🏚️ Sheds & Storage Structures
ARB written approval required before any shed or structure is built
Hillsborough County permit required for sheds > 150 sq ft
Under 150 sq ft: no county permit needed, but ARB approval still required
No temporary/portable storage units, drop boxes, or shacks allowed
Fuel tanks must be in an approved accessory building or screened
Apply for county permit at HillsGovHub (hcfl.gov)
🏗️ ADUs & Accessory Dwellings
All lots are zoned for single-family residential use only
ADUs create a multi-unit use and are not permitted under the Declaration
Florida SB-48 (2025) does NOT preempt recorded HOA deed restrictions
HOA deed restrictions are upheld by FL courts over state/county ADU laws
Garage conversions to living space are expressly prohibited (Decl. §20g)
All new structures require both ARB approval and a county building permit
Consult a FL real estate attorney before pursuing any ADU
📬 Mailboxes
Repairs/replacements: Creative Mailboxes  ·  (813) 818-7100
Approved alternative: classic black metal box, 39" platform height
Post: planted 2–2.5 ft from curb, maximum height of 5 ft
If replacing post, old post must be fully removed
🏠 Renters — Important Notes
Minimum lease term is 30 days — no short-term/vacation rentals
Owner must give HOA 30 days written notice and a copy of the lease
All deed restrictions apply equally to tenants as to owners
Owner is legally responsible for tenant compliance with all rules
Enforcement Request Forms available at boyettecreekhoa.com
